name: Teens Teach, Santa Clara City Library
org: Santa Clara City Library (City of Santa Clara)
what_you_do: Teach a one-time class at the library on a skill you know well. The Teen Librarian helps you plan it. You can earn up to 6 volunteer hours.
duration: One program, plus planning, an interview and a follow-up talk.
deadline_text: Proposals are taken any time. No deadline is stated.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Teens Teach Library Program Proposal Application. Staff reply in about one week and set up an interview. Send your presentation at least one week before your program date. Questions: kguzman@santaclaraca.gov.
notes: Plan to show up 30 minutes early to set up, and dress work casual. The interview questions are listed on the page so you can prepare.
